item.title: Court Documents Detail Assault Charges Against Penn State Hockey Star Gavin McKenna
item.description: An affidavit of probable cause filed by State College police provides more details on the assault charges filed against Penn State men's hockey forward Gavin McKenna following an alleged altercation that left another man with injuries requiring surgery. McKenna, an 18-year-old freshman from Yukon, Canada, was charged late Wednesday afternoon with a felony count of aggravated assault, a misdemeanor count of simple assault and summary offenses of disorderly conduct and harassment. item.title: DA Withdraws Felony Assault Charge Against Gavin McKenna
item.description: Penn State hockey star Gavin McKenna is no longer facing the most serious charge stemming from an altercation in downtown State College on Saturday. item.title: Police: Suspect in Custody, Charges Pending After State College Home Invasion
item.description: A suspect is in custody and charges are pending after an overnight home invasion in State College, according to borough police. item.title: Penn State Wrestling Thrashes Michigan 38-3
item.description: No. 1 Penn State wrestling continued to dominate its dual meet schedule, winning nine of 10 bouts for a 38-3 victory against Michigan on Friday night in Ann Arbor. Luke Lilledahl, Marcus Blaze, Mitchell Mesenbrink, Levi Haines and Josh Barr all won by technical fall, while Shayne Van Ness claimed a major decision.
